MORE: Tyroon Tea Company Ltdhas informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 13/11/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve Pursuant to Regulation 29 read with Regulation 47 of the SEBI (Listing Obligation and Disclosure Requirements) Regulation, 2015, the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled to be held on Friday, the 13th day of November, 2026 at its registered office at 3.30 P.M to consider inter alia unaudited Financial Results for the Quarter and Half Year ended 30th September, 2026.
